body:
Founder: 'then northstar that bitch and build it pure.' Real code, not a stub: S-expression lexer (all bracket kinds, symbols including !-prefixed linear and &/&mut-prefixed borrow forms, :keyword vs standalone ':' disambiguation, @ region marker, escaped strings, numbers, ;/;; comments) + recursive-descent parser building the generic structural AST + a bump arena (zero heap allocation outside it) + a 'parena parse <file>' CLI. Verified against NORTHSTAR.md's own VS0 Definition of Done, domain 1: 32 unit tests (balanced S-expressions including the real test.prn scratch-to-buffer promotion example copied verbatim from the source spec, plus imbalanced ones -- unterminated lists/strings, mismatched bracket kinds, stray closes, each producing a line-numbered error). gcc -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -std=c99 zero warnings. AddressSanitizer+UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer zero errors/leaks (Valgrind not installed in this environment, ASan is the available equivalent). CLI smoke-tested against the real VS0 test.prn. CI added and confirmed green on GitHub (build+test+sanitizers+smoke test). Explicitly NOT built yet, flagged honestly: the region analyzer, C emitter, and full 'parena build' pipeline (DoD's other 4 domains) -- real, scoped follow-up (backlog S189-13, updated not closed). Commit 3bace34.

⚓ ☃
title: VS0 lexer + parser implemented and CI-verified
